description: Map the input to the shape of another model, field by field.

groups.title: Mapping
groups.description: One rule per line: an output field, =, and an input value (input.device.id), a fixed value (25, true, null, "text"), or text with input values ("Device {{input.device.id}}"). Map items of arrays with [], e.g. values[].c = input.readings[].celsius.

inputModelId.title: Input model
inputModelId.description: Model of the input. The input of the step must match it.

outputModelId.title: Output model
outputModelId.description: Model of the output. Every required field must be mapped.
